# Fitness Coaching Platform

Primary business: multilingual personal training and fitness coaching.

- In-person personal training: Toronto and selected Greater Toronto Area locations.
- Online fitness coaching and personalized workout programs: available worldwide.
- Languages: English, Persian (Farsi), French, Spanish.
- Services: in-home personal training, private personal training, online coaching, workout programming, practical general nutrition coaching, beginner and active-aging coaching.
- Client portal: appointments, training plans, nutrition guidance, progress tracking and progress charts.
- Exercise education: searchable exercise library powered by RepDB free-tier data with attribution.
- AI concierge: answers questions about public services, pricing, booking and platform navigation using current site data.

Important: General fitness and nutrition guidance is educational and does not replace medical diagnosis, treatment, physiotherapy, or medical nutrition therapy.
